died.name: Thomas Wolsey
died.cause: to the Lieutenant of the Tower of London, after falling ill on the way to London under arrest for treason
died.last_words: And, Master Kyngston, had I but served God as diligently as I have served the king, he would not have given me over in my gray hairs. But this is my just reward for my pains and study, not regarding my service to God, but only my duty to my Prince.

died.name: John Felton
died.desc: assassin of George Villiers, 1st Duke of Buckingham
died.cause: referring to the killing of Buckingham before being executed by hanging

died.name: Maria Theresa
died.desc: Archduchess of Austria and Queen of Hungary and Croatia
died.cause: when her son said, "Your Majesty cannot be comfortable like that"
died.last_words: No, but comfortable enough to die.

died.name: Antoine Barnave
died.last_words: Better to suffer and to die than to lose one shade of my moral and political character.

died.name: Victims of the Thanksgiving Day Disaster
died.cause: During the 1900 Big Game between the California Golden Bears and the Stanford Cardinal American football teams, a large crowd of people who did not want to pay the $1 admission fee gathered upon the roof of a glass blowing factory to watch for free. The roof then collapsed, severing fuel pipes and causing at least 100 people to fall four stories to the factory floor. 60 to 100 more people fell directly on top of a furnace, the surface temperature of which was estimated to be around 500 °F (260 °C). 23 people were killed, and over 100 more were injured. The disaster remains the deadliest accident at a sporting event in U.S. history.

died.name: Lorentzos Mavilis
died.cause: killed in action at the Battle of Driskos
died.last_words: I expected many honors from this war, but not the added honor that I offer my life for my Greece.

died.name: Zoya Kosmodemyanskaya
died.cause: prior to her execution by Germans in Petrishchevo for arson in there
died.last_words: Farewell, comrades! Fight, do not be afraid! Stalin is with us! Stalin will come!

died.name: Natalie Wood
died.last_words: Help me, someone please help me, I'm drowning.

died.name: Cary Grant

born.last_words: I am going up. Come with me.

born.name: Empress Dowager Cixi
born.last_words: Never again allow a woman to hold the supreme power in the State... [and] be careful not to allow eunuchs to meddle in government affairs.

born.name: C.S. Lewis
born.desc: a British author of The Chronicles of Narnia, literary scholar and Anglican lay theologian
born.cause: of kidney failure, at age 64. He was diagnosed with end-stage kidney failure in mid-November. He collapsed in his bedroom at 5:30 pm on 22 November, at age 64, and died a few minutes later
